apps.name: NekoSurf
apps.subtitle: 🍀 4chan image board viewer for iOS and Android, written in Flutter
apps.localizedDescription:
NekoSurf is a fast, privacy-friendly 4chan viewer built with Flutter for iOS and Android.

It is designed for smooth browsing with modern card-based layouts, media-first navigation, and practical quality-of-life tools for everyday use.

versions.localizedDescription: With iCloud sync on, the change you made last now wins when NekoSurf is open on two devices at once, Clear watched posts clears them everywhere, and bookmarks made before version 0.13.0 are in the same order on all of them.

Replies posted while you were away wait at the bottom of a nested thread, threads count what you haven't read yet, bookmarks look like a board, and saved files fill tiles shaped like their pictures in the Saved tab; files saved before version 0.13.0 are now in the same place on all your devices with iCloud sync on.
NekoSurf no longer closes right after opening in LiveContainer, and a saved video deleted and saved again on another device keeps the same place in the Saved tab everywhere.

Media saved on another device shows up in the Saved tab at once and downloads with a progress ring, and keeps uploading after you leave the app; bookmarks and saved media are in the same order on every device, and Sync now brings in changes straight away.
With iCloud sync on, saved files go up much faster and bookmarks no longer wait for them; the Saved tab and Settings show what's still going up, and a sync log shows what sync did.

Pick Light, Dark or Auto and one of 15 color themes or pure black OLED, hide posts or a poster's posts by ID, name, tripcode, country or text, tap an ID to see all its posts, send feedback or read the privacy policy from Settings, and sync your saved media, bookmarks, history and settings between iPhone and iPad with iCloud, or back them up to a file; scrolling a thread of videos on iPhone no longer freezes for a moment.

Videos in threads start sooner and up to four play at once, they wait out 4chan's download limits and say so, and on iPhone scrolling no longer stutters when the next one starts; swiping back to the home screen no longer jumps, and the Bookmarks tab starts with a summary card.
All of Settings is now on one page, a thread's gallery can show only images or videos, board cards show new replies, and the pull to refresh ring no longer gets stuck on screen.

Spoilers stay covered until tapped, posts show poster IDs and tripcodes, threads can be refreshed by pulling past either end, links to other threads open, code looks like code, a data saver shows only thumbnails, and saved files can take 4chan's file names.

Read threads like comments, with replies nested right under each post and branches you can fold, and swipe right anywhere on a page to go back; replies that start with a number now count as replies to the post they quote.
Save and share several posts at once, with a ring showing how far along each is; saving is faster and more reliable, and going back from a thread no longer brings up the keyboard.

Videos start much sooner on slow connections and show how much has loaded, scrubbing downloads from where you scrub to, images stay on your phone, the app starts faster, and saving and sharing take less space and fewer permissions.
New video player: videos start instantly, zoom into fullscreen, scrub smoothly, and a video cache setting. Fixes a crash when closing the app.
Fixes a crash when leaving the app during a fullscreen video, and the iPhone update notice now waits until TestFlight has the update.
Search all of 4chan or your favorite boards, plus a new History page.
Live-updating threads, a thread gallery, "+N new" on bookmarks, playback speed and auto-advance for videos, and reverse image search.
Android builds now use a permanent signing key. Android users: uninstall once and reinstall this version, then updates work normally. No changes on iOS.
Browse archived threads, much smoother videos with loading progress, instant search and sorting, and lots of speed and memory improvements.
Thread filters by keyword or regex, a tidier home screen that cleans up dead threads, and a fix for launching on iOS 17.0–17.5.
Full visual redesign with new dashboard, media viewer, and saved attachments interface.
Select and bulk-save attachments, browse them in the Files app with their original names, double-tap to zoom.
Improved scrolling smoothness in threads with inline videos.
Pause videos offscreen and more improvements.
Fix media files to display correctly; Adding an update checker on app launch.
Add sticky threads functionality.
Fix performance on specific pages and improve overall stability.
This update fixes some liquid glass issues and improves the overall experience.

This update adds liquid glass.

- Media viewer now shows file names and sizes for better context.
- Overall: better media viewing experience, more context, and improved navigation.

This update makes NekoSurf feel smoother and easier to use.

- Replies are now truly threaded, so conversations are much easier to follow.
- Media viewing is now unified across threads and saved attachments for a more consistent experience.
- Saved attachments and thread UI were cleaned up, improving reliability and overall polish.
- Overall: better conversation flow, cleaner media experience, and a nicer day-to-day feel.
